brand.name: Vivo Fashion Group
brand.vibe: Distinctive, premium fashion-tech, editorial, modern retail
brand.primary_audience: In-store sales associates (tablet) and retail managers (desktop/tablet)

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous whitespace, optical alignment, tablet-first clienteling focus
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento-style grids for dashboard, wide gaps (gap-6 to gap-8)
spacing_and_layout.containers: Cards must have p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision. Max width for forms and settings.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 44px for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) to ensure tablet friendliness.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm for a sharp, editorial, premium feel.

components.buttons: Large touch targets (h-12). Primary: bg-[#1F3864] text-white hover:bg-[#162A4A]. Accent: bg-[#C9A961] text-white hover:bg-[#B3934D]. No hover-only states.
components.cards: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-sm. Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Inner padding p-6 or p-8.
components.inputs: h-12, text-base, clear borders, active state rings in #1F3864. Floating labels or clear bold above.
components.tables: Generous row height (min 60px) for tablet tapping. Clear distinct borders.
components.tabs: Full width on mobile/tablet, large tap targets, active state indicated by bold text and #1F3864 border-bottom.
components.charts: Recharts. Use primary (#1F3864) and accent (#C9A961) for bars/lines. Tooltips must be large and tappable.
components.badges: Subtle background (e.g. bg-[#F3F4F6]) with strong text for tags/preferences.

interactions.motion: Minimal, functional. No hover-dependent reveals. Swipeable carousels for lookbooks.
interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders for data calls. Avoid spinners for full page.
interactions.empty_states: Illustrated with high-quality icons (Lucide), clear message, and a primary action button.
interactions.errors: Inline errors for forms. Toast notifications for failed data mutations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react, recharts, and required shadcn components.
Add fonts (Outfit, Manrope) via Google Fonts in index.html and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the specified colors (Navy #1F3864, Gold #C9A961) and background/surface colors.
Implement the UI focusing on tablet dimensions (768px - 1280px) first.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs) have a minimum height of 44px (e.g., h-12) for tablet tapping.
Avoid using Shadcn's default rounded-md; override border radius to rounded-none or rounded-sm for an editorial premium feel.
In the Lookbook Builder and Customer Profile, use generous whitespace and minimal borders to let the content shine.
Data components must display loading skeletons when fetching from the mock APIs.
Never use purely hover-based actions since the app is tablet-first. Always use tap/click visible buttons.
Ensure the public lookbook view uses the brand's aesthetic (off-white bg, navy headers) without the internal CRM navigation.
